purpose: Teach: カバン/五つ/浴びる/ジャガイモ/年下/指先/注意深く/かすか

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のカバン、結構、年季入ってるよな、長く、使ってるんだよね。
lines.en: Your bag's looking pretty worn out — you've had that thing forever, haven't you?
lines.style: Light, teasing tone. Observational, not quite a jab. Quick pace, easy confidence. The setup for something playful.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。文化祭の出し物、五つくらい、候補、出てたぜ、絞るの、難しかった。
lines.en: Yeah. For the culture fest, we had about five ideas for our performance. It was actually pretty hard to narrow it down.
lines.style: Thoughtful, looking back. Pace slows slightly on the difficulty part. Genuine reflection, not complaining. Open tone, like he's thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 体育の後、シャワー、浴びるの、最高に気持ちいいよね、運動後、本当に。
lines.en: A shower after PE is seriously the best — like, the feeling right after you're done exercising is just incredible.
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm. Sharp opening attack on the first phrase. Warm, bright pace. Slight uptick in energy on 'incredible' — she means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お母さんの料理、ジャガイモのコロッケ、めっちゃ、美味いんだぜ、家庭の味、最強だ。
lines.en: My mom's potato croquettes are seriously delicious, dude. That home cooking taste is just unbeatable.
lines.style: Animated admiration, unguarded. Warm tone on 'seriously'. Pace picks up slightly on 'unbeatable' — conviction without aggression. Genuine fondness underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 部活、年下の後輩に、優しく、接しないとね、リク、私たち、お手本ね。
lines.en: You have to be kind to the underclassmen in the club, you know — we're supposed to set the example, Riku.
lines.style: Shifts to gentle authority. Not lecturing — more like a quiet reminder between friends. Calm, steady pace. Slight emphasis on 'we,' like she's including him in something.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の指先、繊細だな、絵を描く時、本当に、芸術的だぜ、桜。
lines.en: Your fingers are so delicate, Sakura — the way you draw is really something. It's like watching art happen.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Genuine, slightly vulnerable. Pace relaxes on her name. Not rehearsed — like the words are coming as he notices again.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生の話、注意深く、聞いてないと、テスト、できないよ、リク、わかる?
lines.en: You have to actually listen carefully to what the teacher says, or you're not going to pass the test, Riku. You get that, right?
lines.style: Wry, affectionate chiding. Not harsh. Quick, pointed pace on the first part. Slight soften on his name — she's testing him, not attacking him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 夜、廊下、かすかに、足音、聞こえてさ、ちょっと、怖かったぜ、桜。
lines.en: Last night I heard faint footsteps in the hallway — it kind of spooked me, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, hesitant. Low energy. Slower pace. Slight vulnerability underneath — he's admitting something that bothered him. Trailing-off at the end, like he doesn't want to make it bigger than it was.
